; @language: frm-like/1
; @stdlib: 1
; @numeric-profile: standard32
; @classic-guards: hyperbolic-clamp
Formula_28c77140_c5f9_557a_93d7_cac12cf08e63 {
  init:
    orbitPixel = pixel
    if !ismand
      orbitPixel = c
      sinusoid = sin(orbitPixel)
      z = pixel
    else
      sinusoid = sin(pixel)
      z = (0, 0)
    endif
  loop:
    z = z * z + sinusoid
  bailout:
    |z| < 4
}

; @language: frm-like/1

Formula_2f0a0f01_53ee_585e_b2bd_6179a0413df1 {

      orbitPixel = c
      pointValue = orbitPixel
      z = pixel
    else

    endif
  loop:

  bailout:

}

; @language: frm-like/1

; @classic-guards: zero-division
Formula_31680a23_4d7e_5844_a598_9682609d0ade {
  parameters:
    pixelSource: real = 0 domain [0, 1]
    pixelConstant: complex = (0, 0)
  init:
    orbitPixel = pixel
    if pixelSource == 1
      orbitPixel = pixelConstant
      z = pixel
    else
      z = (0, 0)
    endif
  loop:
    z = 1 / flip(sqr(z) + orbitPixel)
  bailout:
    |z| <= 4
}

; @language: frm-like/1

Formula_6df24dea_4668_5590_b251_c9bf208aa45d {
  init:
    orbitPixel = pixel
    if !ismand
      orbitPixel = c
      x = real(orbitPixel)
      y = imag(orbitPixel)
      orbitConstant = x * (cos(y) + x * sin(y))
      z = pixel
    else
      x = real(pixel)
      y = imag(pixel)
      orbitConstant = x * (cos(y) + x * sin(y))
      z = 0
    endif
  loop:
    z = sqr(z) + orbitConstant
  bailout:
    |z| < 4
}

; @language: frm-like/1
; @stdlib: 1
; @numeric-profile: standard32
Formula_cefe7738_0e8a_547f_ac85_ac3db2529907 {
  parameters:
    offset: complex = (0, 0) classic p1
    pixelSource: real = 0 domain [0, 1]
    pixelConstant: complex = (0, 0)
  init:
    orbitPixel = pixel
    if pixelSource == 1
      orbitPixel = pixelConstant
      carrier = orbitPixel
      z = pixel
    else
      carrier = pixel
      z = (0.5, 0)
    endif
  loop:
    xCoord = real(z)
    yCoord = imag(z)
    nextX = -carrier * (xCoord - xCoord * xCoord + yCoord * yCoord) + offset
    twist = -carrier * (yCoord - 2 * xCoord * yCoord)
    z = nextX + flip(twist)
  bailout:
    |z| <= 100
}

; @language: frm-like/1
; @stdlib: 1
; @numeric-profile: standard32
Formula_d170fae4_0295_5149_84e8_acf7254c7162 {
  parameters:
    pixelSource: real = 0 domain [0, 1]
    pixelConstant: complex = (0, 0)
  init:
    orbitPixel = pixel
    if pixelSource == 1
      orbitPixel = pixelConstant
      seed = orbitPixel
      z = pixel
    else
      seed = pixel
      z = (0, 0)
    endif
  loop:
    xCoord = real(z)
    yCoord = imag(z)
    squarePart = xCoord * xCoord - yCoord * yCoord
    crossPart = 2 * xCoord * yCoord
    z = squarePart + crossPart + seed
  bailout:
    |z| < 4
}

; @language: frm-like/1

; @classic-guards: zero-division
Formula_ded18937_1f80_5248_a6f2_be82db2b676e {
  parameters:
    transform: function = identity classic fn1
    pixelSource: real = 0 domain [0, 1]
    pixelConstant: complex = (0, 0)
  init:
    orbitPixel = pixel
    if pixelSource == 1
      orbitPixel = pixelConstant
      z = pixel
    else
      z = 0.5
    endif
  loop:
    z = z * orbitPixel - orbitPixel / transform(z)
  bailout:
    |z| < 8
}

; @language: frm-like/1
; @stdlib: 1
; @numeric-profile: standard32
Formula_fd6c2fac_31db_55f1_9d93_726bd261671d {
  parameters:
    parameter1: complex = (0, 0) classic p1
    pixelSource: real = 0 domain [0, 1]
    pixelConstant: complex = (0, 0)
  init:
    orbitPixel = pixel
    if pixelSource == 1
      orbitPixel = pixelConstant
      z = pixel
      x = |z|
    else
      z = p1
      x = |z|
    endif
  loop:
    if 0.9999999999 < x
      z = cosh(z) + orbitPixel
    endif
    z = sqr(z) + orbitPixel
    x = |z|
  bailout:
    x <= 4
}
